title: I one-shotted Half Life with Claude Opus
author: Medium_Aspect_8784
selftext:
Half-Sketch is the whole of Half-Life, abridged and scribbled in pencil across a physics notebook, told in one continuous, unbroken shot (7½ minutes). Every frame is drawn and every note of the lo-fi score is synthesized in code with Claude Opus: no footage, no samples, no game assets. It plays live in your browser.

It went well enough that the stick figures kept going: **Bio·Shtick** does BioShock in art-deco gold leaf, and **Pratfallout** does Fallout as an atomic-age cartoon, survived mostly by falling over.

Watch all three: https://stickman.tripgeo.com
